content.value_statement: Prisma v7 changed client generation, adapters, and configuration. This skill gives concise patterns for setup, migration, queries, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Explains Prisma v7 ESM requirements and generator output changes.
Shows how to configure prisma.config.ts and driver adapters.
Guides upgrades from Prisma v6 to Prisma v7.
Provides schema, relation, migration, and Prisma Client query patterns.
Covers common troubleshooting steps for generation, connection, and migration issues.
Summarizes security and performance practices for Prisma applications.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not inspect a live database.
It cannot verify installed package versions without project context.
It does not replace review of production migration plans.
Database-specific edge cases may need vendor documentation.

use_cases.title: Start a Prisma v7 Project
use_cases.description: Set up Prisma v7 with ESM, generated client output, a driver adapter, and environment-based configuration.

use_cases.title: Upgrade from Prisma v6
use_cases.description: Plan package updates, adapter installation, client regeneration, and schema configuration changes for a v7 migration.

use_cases.title: Standardize Database Patterns
use_cases.description: Create consistent guidance for schema relations, migrations, query shapes, pooling, and operational troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the prisma-v7 skill to outline a Prisma v7 setup for a TypeScript PostgreSQL project. Include required packages, config files, and first migration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the prisma-v7 skill to review my Prisma schema for v7 compatibility, relation design, indexes, generator output, and datasource configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot Generation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the prisma-v7 skill to diagnose why Prisma Client generation fails after an upgrade. Ask for missing project details before recommending commands.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the prisma-v7 skill to create a staged v6 to v7 migration plan for a production TypeScript service with PostgreSQL and connection pooling.

output_examples.input: I need to start Prisma v7 with PostgreSQL in a TypeScript service.
output_examples.output: A setup checklist covering ESM, Prisma packages, the PostgreSQL adapter, prisma.config.ts, generated client output, and first migration steps.

output_examples.input: My Prisma v6 project needs to move to v7.
output_examples.output: An upgrade plan that separates package updates, adapter selection, datasource changes, client import updates, and migration validation.

output_examples.input: Prisma Client cannot find the generated module after generation.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting path that checks generator output, import paths, ESM settings, regeneration, and TypeScript server state.

best_practices: Confirm the database adapter before changing client instantiation.
Keep database URLs in environment variables and out of schema files.
Test migrations on staging before applying them to production.
anti_patterns: Using Prisma v6 client defaults without reviewing v7 output changes.
Running reset or push commands against production databases.
Hardcoding credentials or connection URLs in application source files.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Prisma commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for commands that users may choose to run in their own projects.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does Prisma v7 require driver adapters?
faq.answer: The skill explains adapter-based setup and shows common adapter choices for supported databases.

faq.question: Can it help with Prisma v6 upgrades?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers package updates, adapter installation, client regeneration, and v7 configuration changes.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It advises environment variables, parameterized queries, limited exposed fields, and safe handling of .env files.

faq.question: Can it validate my production database?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest checks, but it cannot inspect live databases or prove that a migration is safe.
